common.tagline: A research pipeline where people approve every stage

nav.signOutFailed: Could not sign out. Try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Use the email and password from your lab invitation.
login.help: No account, or forgot your password? Ask a lab admin for a new link.

reset.title: Set your password
reset.description: Choose a password for your account. This link works only once.
reset.hint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.
reset.tooShort: The password needs at least {min} characters.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
reset.invalidDescription: It was already used or it has expired. Ask a lab admin for a new one.
reset.doneDescription: You can now sign in with your new password.

errors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask a lab admin for a new one.
errors.TOKEN_EXPIRED: This link has expired. Ask a lab admin for a new one.
errors.BANNED_USER: This account is suspended. Contact a lab admin.
errors.INVALID_ORIGIN: The request was blocked for security reasons. Reload the page and try again.
errors.MISSING_OR_NULL_ORIGIN: The request was blocked for security reasons. Reload the page and try again.
errors.YOU_ARE_NOT_ALLOWED_TO_CREATE_USERS: Only lab admins can invite people.
errors.YOU_ARE_NOT_ALLOWED_TO_LIST_USERS: Only lab admins can manage users.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

auth.required: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
auth.unavailable: The sign-in service is unavailable. Try again shortly.

csrf.origin_mismatch: The request was blocked for security reasons. Reload the page and try again.

permission.denied: You do not have permission to do that.

project.not_found: Project not found, or you are not a member.

run.not_retryable: This run is still in progress, so it can't be retried yet.

user.not_found: No user has this email. Ask a lab admin to invite them first.

stage_output.not_found: That stage output no longer exists.

approval.stale: The output changed since you opened it. Review the latest version.
approval.duplicate: A decision on this output was already recorded.
approval.rejected_by_workflow: The workflow no longer accepts a decision on this output.
approval.expired: Nobody decided in time, so the run was cancelled.

orchestrator.unavailable: The workflow engine is unavailable, so the run could not start. Try again later.

db.unavailable: The database is unavailable. Try again shortly.
db.error: A database error stopped the stage. Retry the run once the database is back.

gateway.error: The LLM gateway kept failing, so the stage stopped. Retry the run later.

stage.error: A stage failed. The event log may say more.
stage.too_many_attempts: The stage was retried too many times (at most 3 attempts).
stage.invalid_output: A stage returned output that does not match its expected format.
stage.not_reached: This run never reached that stage, so it can't be retried from there.

lab_balance.exhausted: The lab's LLM balance is used up.

free_models.disabled: This project does not allow free models, and paid models are not available.

free_quota.exhausted: The lab's free-model quota is used up for now. Try again later.

validation.failed: Some fields are not valid. Check them and try again.

network.error: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.

server.error: The server had a problem. Try again shortly.

decision.invalid: That decision isn't possible for this output.
decision.edit_requires_approve: Edits can only be saved together with an approval.
decision.invalid_edit: The edited output doesn't match this stage's format. Check the fields and try again.
decision.edit_too_large: The edited output is too large to save. Shorten it and try again.
decision.no_attempts_left: No change requests are left for this output. Approve it (with or without edits) or reject it.
decision.comment_required: Say what should change before requesting changes.

member.last_owner: A project needs at least one owner.
member.not_found: That person is not a member of this project.
member.exists: This person is already a member. Change their role in the member list instead.

papers.invalid_year_range: The start year must not be after the end year.

literature.no_papers: No paper matched the search, or screening left none to read. Try a broader topic or a wider range of years.

stage.placeholder: this stage is not implemented yet, so it returned a stand-in result.
stage.demo: this stage isn't built yet, so it shows realistic demo output.

literature.search_pending: the literature search is not connected yet.
literature.demo_search: the search plan is real, but the papers, analyses and synthesis are demo data until the literature search is connected.
literature.partial_search: some sources could not be searched (an error or their daily quota), so papers from them may be missing.
literature.no_full_text: no open-access full text was found for the included papers, so the analyses are based on their abstracts.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page does not exist, or you do not have access to it.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.description: This page hit an unexpected error.

invite.subject: You're invited to {appName}
invite.body:
Hello {name},

An administrator created an account for you on {appName}. Open this link to choose your password:

{url}

The link works once and expires in {hours} hours. If you did not expect this email, you can ignore it.

reset.subject: Set a new password for {appName}
reset.body:
Hello {name},

Use this link to set a new password for your {appName} account:

{url}

The link works once and expires in {hours} hours. If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.
